_readme: Story text for the screens. Writers can change any sentence. Do not change the names on the left side of the colons (the keys), or the game cannot find the text.

lines: A rocket waits on the launch pad. Something is about to go very wrong.

name_screen.title: First things first. What is your name?

mission_screen.title: What is the mission for?
mission_screen.goal_heading: The mission is a success if:

build_screen.title: Build your spacecraft. Pick one of each.

review_screen.title: Before launch: does it all add up?

ship._readme: Names on the ship. room_names = the sign above each room's doorway (left side of the colon must match the room names in game_data.json). future_stations = the floating label over each glowing floor marker.

walk_screen.controls_hint: WASD = walk    Space = jump    Mouse = look    E = use    Tab = raise arm (dashboard)    Esc = free the mouse

scientist.name: The Scientist
scientist.description: You know spacecraft, orbits and Mars better than anyone in the room. The general just needs you to decide.

janitor.name: The Janitor
janitor.description: You know every room in this building. You know nothing about spacecraft.

student.name: The Student
student.description: You came on a school tour and took a wrong turn. You know a little from class. The general points at you anyway.

mars_orbit.name: Mars orbit
mars_orbit.description: Fly to Mars and circle around it, high above the surface. From up there, the spacecraft can look at the whole planet.

launch_vehicles._readme: Plain names on purpose: the numbers are made up for now, so we do not use real rocket names.

small.name: Small rocket
small.description: The cheapest. But it has the most launch moments, and the timing is tight.

medium.name: Medium rocket
medium.description: A middle price, with a middle number of launch moments and normal timing.

large.name: Large rocket
large.description: The most expensive. But it has the fewest launch moments, and the timing is forgiving.

mars_ice.name: Map the ice on Mars
mars_ice.description: Send a spacecraft to orbit Mars and take pictures to find where the ice is. Future astronauts will need that water.

goal_rules._readme: One sentence for each goal rule. {value} and {unit} are filled in from the mission limits in game_data.json.

crew_supplies._readme: The Crew supplies group on the arm dashboard (shown in Flight and Arrival only). names and units = the words on each row. of_word = the words between the amount left and the full size, for example "1250 kg of 1300".
crew_supplies.title: Crew supplies

flight._readme: Words on the screen during Flight (Stage 3): the Life Support stations. prompts = the line shown near a station (after "Press E:"); the _done and _none lines show when there is nothing left to do. ration_panel = the Food station's little screen.

prompts.air: Air station: run the oxygen generator
prompts.air_done: Air station: the oxygen generator is running

ration_panel.title: FOOD STATION
ration_panel.body: Rationing means the crew eats a little less each day, so the food lasts longer. Once it is on, it stays on.

flight.leak_banner: WATER LEAK! Go to the Water station

timed_press_test._readme: Words for the timed-press test bench (scenes/timed_press_test.tscn).
timed_press_test.title: Timed press test
timed_press_test.label: PRESS NOW
timed_press_test.hint: Press {key} (or click) when the ring closes on the target.

launch_screen._readme: Words for the Launch screen (Stage 2). moments = the names of the launch moments. cost_kinds = how a Miss cost is written ({amount} is a percent).
launch_screen.title: Launch!
launch_screen.hint: Press SPACE (or click) when the ring closes on the target.

cutscene_intro._readme: Words for the intro cutscene in scenes/cutscene_intro.tscn.

subtitles._readme: The subtitle lines at the bottom of the cutscene. Each line has a speaker name (shown in amber) and the words (shown in white). The AnimationPlayer calls show_subtitle with one of these names at the right time.

general_who.speaker: General
general_who.text: This mission launches on schedule. Who will run it?

orbit_burn_screen._readme: Words for the Orbit burn screen (Stage 4, before the walk). The cost text uses launch_screen.cost_kinds ({amount} is a percent).
orbit_burn_screen.title: Orbit burn
orbit_burn_screen.hint: Press E (or click) when the ring closes on the target.
orbit_burn_screen.no_loss: No losses. We are in orbit!
